# obol.terms

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../../sdk/index.md).

:::

The Obol terms and conditions must be accepted once per address before it can create a cluster definition or accept an invite. Acceptance is an EIP-712 signature (without a chain id) posted to the Obol API.

## Reads {#group-reads}

### terms.hasAccepted {#hasAccepted}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">api</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#setup">1. Set up the client</a></div>

Whether `address` (default: the wallet account) has accepted the latest Obol terms
and conditions. Neither an address nor a wallet: WALLET_REQUIRED.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.terms.hasAccepted(
  address?: string,
): Promise<boolean>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>address?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { terms } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const accepted = await obol.terms.hasAccepted(); // the wallet account; or pass an address
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: terms.hasAccepted</summary>

Tag: `api`. Input: `address?` (default the wallet account; neither → [`WALLET_REQUIRED`](../errors.md#WALLET_REQUIRED)). Output: `bool` from
`GET /v1/termsAndConditions/:address` `isTermsAndConditionsSigned`. (2.15)

## Signing and API writes {#group-signing}

### terms.accept {#accept}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">api (+ wallet)</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#setup">1. Set up the client</a></div>

Signs the terms and conditions (EIP-712, no chain id) with the wallet and posts the
acceptance. `ifNotAccepted: true` signs only when the account has not accepted yet
(`{ signed: false }` otherwise). Needed once per address before [`cluster.create`](./cluster.md#create) or
[`cluster.accept`](./cluster.md#accept).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.terms.accept(input?: {
  ifNotAccepted?: boolean;
}): Promise<{ signed: boolean }>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">{ ifNotAccepted?: boolean }</span> |  |
| <code>input.ifNotAccepted?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;{ signed: boolean }&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { terms } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

await obol.terms.accept({ ifNotAccepted: true }); // signs only if not accepted yet
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: terms.accept</summary>

Tag: `api` (+ wallet). Input: `{ ifNotAccepted: bool? }`. Signs `TermsAndConditions { terms_and_conditions_hash,
version: 1 }` with the domain without `chainId` and posts `{ address, version, terms_and_conditions_hash, fork_version
}` to `POST /v1/termsAndConditions`. With `ifNotAccepted`, `hasAccepted` first and return without signing. 409 →
[`API_CONFLICT`](../errors.md#API_CONFLICT) (already accepted). (2.15)

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#termsaccept">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/schemas/terms.accept.json">input JSON Schema</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/terms/terms.ts#L131">source</a></p>
